items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 11 at 9:57AM EDT until October 11 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents. A strong south to north longshore
current is also expected for east and southeast-facing beaches.

* WHERE...Coastal Pender, Coastal New Hanover and Coastal
Brunswick Counties.

* WHEN...Today.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: The High Surf Advisory has been cancelled.
items.description: The High Surf Advisory has been cancelled and is no longer in effect.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 11 at 2:10AM EDT until October 12 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
